title: Only A Shadow Between
firstLine: I have a home in a fair summer land,

lines: I have a home in a fair summer land,
Its beauties I never have seen,
I have a place on an evergreen strand,
Jesus has promised a home to prepare,
Thru faith on this promise I lean,
I have a mansion that's wondrously fair,
When I have finished my task here below,
I pass thru this shadowy screen,
Be with the ransomed forever I know,
Only a shadow, a shadow between,
One step to go, O the way's all aglow,
